text:
Alex R: Heads-up — PM says marketing is planning a week-long promo in mid-May, likely a 2-3x traffic spike for hosted customers. We need a hedging plan for GPU capacity ASAP.
Priya S: Do we have a baseline forecast?
Alex R: Baseline currently ~24k GPU-hours/week across US+EU. Worst-case promo bump we estimated in the deck: 2.5x => ~60k GPU-hours/week for that period.
Dan M: H200 lead times still painful, vendors quoting 10–14 weeks. Not realistic for a May blast unless we had reservations already.
Marisol G: We can reallocate some Dedicated pools, but will impact SLAs for a few enterprise customers. Need approval for temporary SLA exceptions.
Kai L: Quick options: 1) short-term L40S spin up in cloud regions that support it, 2) H100 burst from our spot pools, 3) cross-region routing to APAC if latency acceptable.
Priya S: Can you sketch cost/time tradeoffs? Even rough per-hour numbers help the decisions team.
Dan M: Rough back-of-envelope: H200 reserved (if we had it) ~ $6.8 / GPU-hour effective, H100 on-demand ~ $3.5, L40S ~ $2.4 — but L40S gives ~0.6x throughput for our long-context models.
Alex R: Important: throughput-per-dollar matters for latency SLOs. If L40S gives fewer tokens/sec we blow out tail latency and need bigger pools.
Marisol G: Also watch KV cache warmup — if we cold-start a lot of nodes we lose effective throughput first 30–60 minutes. Caching + prewarmed pods helps.
Priya S: Procurement asked what to order if we decide to reserve. Can we do a hybrid: prebook partial H200 for long-term, supplement with H100/L40S for the spike?
Dan M: Hybrid seems pragmatic. Recommendation: submit a modest H200 reservation request for Q3 (hedge backlog) and cover May surge with H100 spot + leased L40S in 2 regions. That avoids 14-week risk.
Marisol G: If we go hybrid, need routing policy change to prefer cost-tiered model variants. I can change Canary rules but need a rollout window.
Alex R: Timeline: marketing confirms promo date in 3 business days. Procurement needs PO by EOD Friday if we want expedited supplier quotes.
procurement-bot: Vendor check complete — vendor X has limited H200 80-card pods, earliest ship 12 weeks. Vendor Y can do partial H100 orders in 6 weeks.
Kai L: Networking flag: APAC colo has limited rack power until new PDUs arrive (2-week lead). If we route to APAC we'll need temporary power waiver or smaller racks.
Priya S: Action items: (1) Dan/Kai produce 72-hr surge runbook with exact GPU-hour burn scenarios and per-region routing plan; (2) Marisol draft SLA exception language and Canary rollout steps; (3) Procurement to request 3 vendor quotes for H100/H200 options and quick PO estimate.
Dan M: I'll put up a short runbook and a table with scenarios. Example table: 
```
Scenario | GPU-hrs/week | Mix (H200/H100/L40S) | Estimated $/week
Baseline | 24,000 | 60/30/10 | $~90k
Promo (2.5x) | 60,000 | 20/60/20 | $~190k
Max (3x) | 72,000 | 10/70/20 | $~230k
```
Kai L: I'll add network constraints per region to the same doc (power, cabling, peering).
Marisol G: I'll draft a short email for affected customers about temporary capacity shifts (transparency).
Alex R: Good. Keep this thread tight — I'll escalate to ops leadership if procurement says >10 weeks for anything critical.
Priya S: One more thought — can Optimize team prepare per-route batching/kv tweaks to squeeze extra tokens/sec for L40S? That could change mix economics.
Dan M: Nice call. I'll sync with Optimize tomorrow morning and incorporate potential 15–25% throughput gains into the numbers.
procurement-bot: Quote request submitted to vendors X/Y/Z. ETA for quotes: 48h.
Alex R: Thanks all — deadline to finalize: 72 hours. We'll reconvene in this thread after the vendor quotes land. :thumbsup:
